item.title: Ohio State Forward Brandon Noel Sustains Foot Injury Vs. Nebraska, Out Indefinitely
item.description: Ohio State's top bench scorer is out indefinitely. Power forward Brandon Noel, a redshirt senior and Wright State transfer, injured his foot during the Buckeyes' loss to No. 10 Nebraska and did not return to the game. He was placed in a walking boot, per an Ohio State spokesperson. Then, on his radio show Wednesday, Ohio State coach Jake Diebler broke the bad news that Noel's injury will hold him out long-term. item.title: Defensive Tackle Maxwell Roy Enters Transfer Portal After One Season With Ohio State
item.description: Another 2025 freshman has entered the transfer portal after just one season at Ohio State. Defensive tackle Maxwell Roy is the latest portal entrant for the Buckeyes, the 21st total and fourth prospect from the recruiting class of 2025. Ohio State true freshman DT Maxwell Roy (@MaxwellRoy8) plans to enter the transfer portal, his rep @J_FrioEsq tells @CBSSports. item.title: Jaloni Cambridge Becomes Fourth Ohio State Women’s Basketball Player to Score 40 or More Points in A Game
item.description: Jaloni Cambridge had one of the most prolific scoring games in Ohio State women’s basketball history on Wednesday night. The sophomore guard scored 41 points in the Buckeyes’ 78-69 win at Illinois, becoming just the fourth player in Ohio State women’s basketball history to top 40 points in a game. Cambridge made 15 shots on 25 attempts, including two 3-pointers on five attempts, and went nine of 12 from the free-throw line to reach her career-high scoring total.
